::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 65,288 people lived in County Monaghan, up 6.4% on 2016. It had the 23rd largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 33% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Monaghan was €1,028, the third lowest of the 26 counties.
:::
